description: Whether a field is the armed services' own, from the FAA's NASR APT_BASE.csv: OWNERSHIP_TYPE_CODE MA (Air Force), MN (Navy), MR (Army) or CG (Coast Guard) is; "joint" where FACILITY_USE_CODE is PU, open to the public as well (a civil airport on a military one, where a civil pilot may land), else "military", where a civil airplane lands only with the service's permission (for the Air Force a Civil Aircraft Landing Permit, 32 CFR part 855); null for any other owner. The one statement the planner, the cycle pack's overlays and the engine's map pins read.

ownership.description: NASR APT_BASE's OWNERSHIP_TYPE_CODE (PU, PR, MA, MN, MR, CG).

military.description: military, joint, or null for a field the services do not own.
